jobs.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
jobs.location: USA - New York City - New York
jobs.description:
As a Director, Corporate Strategy reporting to VP, Head of Transformation Office, you'll play a critical role in driving enterprise-wide strategic initiatives that fundamentally transform how Nasdaq operates. You will partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact programs that shape the future of our organization.

You'll thrive in this position if you're collaborative, strategic, and passionate about driving change in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead strategic initiatives from planning through execution, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and measurable outcomes.

- Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and performance metrics to drive accountability and progress.

- Conduct change impact assessments and develop mitigation strategies to minimize risk and maximize adoption.

- Partner with stakeholders across time zones and functions to ensure seamless integration and a positive culture for change.

- Coach and support teams to build capabilities, foster engagement, and sustain momentum throughout the transformation journey.

- Draft and deliver Executive-ready updates and communications on initiative progress.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business, organizational development, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience leading large-scale transformation or change management programs in complex environments.

- Strong ability to influence stakeholders, build relationships, and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of delivering solutions to complex challenges.

- Proficiency in program management methodologies and change management frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced degree or certification (e.g., MBA, PMP, etc.).

- Experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.

- Familiarity with working across global teams and navigating cultural dynamics.

This position will be located in New York Headquarters and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Transformation Program Lead — FinTech Strategy
jobs.description:
The Role

As a Transformation Program Lead reporting to the Sr Director, Product Portfolio Operations & Transformation, you will shape and stand up the cross-functional programs that change how Nasdaq’s Financial Technology division operates and competes. You will work in the FinTech Strategy and Transformation Team, responsible for defining the strategic agenda for Nasdaq’s Financial Technology division. You will partner with senior stakeholders across Product Strategy, Product & Engineering, Client Experience, Sales, and Finance to execute on division-critical priorities.
You will thrive in this position if you’re a structured thinker who can turn ambiguity into a clear problem statement and program design, manage senior stakeholder relations, and communicate with executive presence in a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Scope and stand-up transformation programs - define the problem, design the program structure, set targets and success measures, and set the execution plan.

- Run critical transformation programs end to end, including governance, milestones, dependencies, and escalation.

- Manage reporting and tracking for a defined set of key initiatives, ensuring leadership has a single, reliable view of progress and value.

- Support the FinTech strategic and transformation communications agenda, by producing executive-ready narratives and updates on the strategic priorities portfolio.

- Conduct targeted business reviews - deep-dive analysis that surface improvement opportunities and convert findings into scoped change programs.

- Support and drive the development of key business initiatives and associated business cases as needed, partnering with Product Strategy and Finance.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, economics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Proven experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation- or enterprise program leadership in complex, cross-functional environments.

- Proven track record scoping and delivering large-scale strategic change programs -- AI and technology-enabled transformation, and cost and productivity programs are a plus.

- Strong structured problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear, executive-ready frameworks.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and hold senior stakeholders accountable without direct authority.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills (English), including executive-level storytelling and materials.

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree (e.g., MBA) or relevant certification

- Experience in financial services, fintech, capital markets, or other regulated industries.

- Ability to work across global teams and time zones.

Benefits & Rewards

We offer a competitive, well-rounded rewards package designed to support the financial, physical, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families (where applicable). Actual pay depends on factors like your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. In addition to base pay, we offer short-term incentives (bonus or commission) and long-term incentives (equity), where applicable. We utilize a structured job architecture and career framework to ensure growth opportunities are transparent, fair, and accessible to all employees.

Other benefits are:

jobs.title: Head of Market Intelligence (Corporate Strategy)
jobs.location: USA - New York City - New York
jobs.description:
As Head of Market Intelligence (Corporate Strategy) reporting to the SVP, Global Head of Corporate Strategy, you will shape how Nasdaq understands the durable trends impacting our ecosystem, competitive landscape and strategic positioning, and long term opportunity creation for the Enterprise. You'll thrive here if you're a structured thinker who can translate complexity into clarity, lead with intellectual and analytical rigor, and bring both strategic depth and executive presence to everything you do.

Key Responsibilities
- Trends:  Analyze macro, industry, regulatory, and technology trends to surface actionable implications for Nasdaq's ecosystem and our long-term strategy.
- Competitive Analysis:  Develop and maintain deep competitive intelligence on key players and industry dynamics, assessing positioning, leverage points, platform advantages, and future-state predictions.
- Long-Term Valuation:  Quantify enterprise value creation opportunities through revenue and profit pool analyses, capital allocation trade-offs, and portfolio attractiveness assessments across growth and efficiency dimensions.
- Market Share:  Work with the Business Units to help build and maintain market share analyses — including TAM/SAM assessments and market share capture models — to identify and prioritize Nasdaq's highest-value growth opportunities.

- Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present with executive presence.

jobs.title: Verafin - Lead Fraud Intelligence & Strategy Analyst
jobs.location: USA - New York City - New York
jobs.description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Fraud Intelligence & Strategy Analyst to join our team at Verafin. Reporting to an AVP of Product Strategy, you’ll work with one of the largest consolidated fraud data sets in financial services, using transaction and fraud data from across our network to uncover emerging threats, identify patterns, and help financial institutions strengthen their fraud strategies.

You’ll work at the intersection of fraud threat intelligence, data analysis, and client strategy, turning complex data into actionable insights for our clients, product teams, and internal partners.

You’ll fit right in if you’re naturally curious, analytical, and investigative, and you love digging into data to understand not only what is happening, but why.

What You’ll Do
- Hunt for emerging fraud threats and patterns across transaction data, case data, marked fraud, and other signals within the Verafin network.

- Turn fraud intelligence into actionable insights, helping clients and internal teams quickly understand emerging activity, attack patterns, and opportunities to respond.

- Analyze how enterprise clients use Verafin scores and data within their fraud strategies and identify opportunities to improve fraud detection and reduce false positives.

- Partner across Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to translate your findings into client recommendations, product improvements, and broader fraud intelligence.

- Help scale how we analyze fraud, exploring automation, AI, and data architecture improvements that make threat hunting and strategy analysis more repeatable and efficient.

What You’ll Bring
- 5+ years of experience in fraud analytics, fraud strategy, or related areas.

- Strong SQL and data analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex transactional data sets.

- Strong understanding of fraud typologies and financial services, including areas such as scams, account takeover, and payment fraud.

- Proven ability to spot patterns and anomalies in complex data and turn them into clear, practical recommendations.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tell a compelling data story to both technical teams and non-technical clients.

Nice to Have
- Experience with AI/ML concepts, automation, or agentic AI tools.

- Experience working with enterprise financial institutions or within fraud/cybersecurity threat intelligence.

- Familiarity with payment systems and analytical tools, including Python, R, or data visualization platforms.

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
As a   Senior FP&A Analyst   within the Workflow & Insights Finance team, you'll play an important role in supporting financial planning, forecasting, business performance analysis, expense management, and strategic decision-making across the business. This role goes beyond traditional FP&A responsibilities, offering exposure to strategic finance, AI-enabled finance processes, and business transformation initiatives that help build the future of finance at Nasdaq.

You'll thrive in this position if you're analytical, curious, and proactive, with strong business acumen and a passion for turning financial and operational data into meaningful business insights. You enjoy using data, analytics, technology, and AI-enabled tools to improve decision-making, simplify processes, and enhance forecasting accuracy. We're looking for someone who applies critical thinking when evaluating information, communicates complex financial concepts clearly to a broad range of audiences, and embraces a continuous learning perspective while adapting to new technologies and ways of working.

Key Responsibilities
- Handle month-end and quarter-end close activities, including accruals, purchase order and invoice tracking, variance analysis, and management reporting.
- Support monthly forecasting, annual budgeting, and long-range planning processes while identifying risks and opportunities and providing actionable recommendations to improve financial performance.
- Partner with business leaders on spending trends, resource requirements, investment priorities, workforce planning, vendor management, efficiency analysis, and operating expense optimization initiatives.
- Prepare financial analyses, performance reporting, KPIs, and executive-level materials that support business leadership, Corporate FP&A, and senior Finance stakeholders in making informed decisions.
- Support business transformation and strategic initiatives while helping improve forecasting, reporting, and planning processes through automation, data-driven insights, and AI-enabled solutions.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field.
- Shown experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Finance, Accounting, Strategic Finance, or Business Analytics.
- Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate financial and operational information into clear business recommendations.
- Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large and complex datasets. Experience with financial planning, reporting, and analytics tools such as Power BI, OneStream, Workday, Anaplan, Salesforce, Databricks, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or similar platforms is highly valued.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting technology, FinTech, SaaS, subscription-based, information services, or other data-driven businesses.
- Experience with planning, reporting, and analytics tools such as OneStream, Workday, Anaplan, Salesforce, Power BI, Databricks, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or similar platforms.
- Experience with workforce planning, long-range planning, business case development, strategic finance, process automation, business intelligence, AI tools, or finance transformation initiatives.

jobs.title: Specialist Enterprise Performance Management Technical - Onestream / Anaplan (FP&A)-1
jobs.description:
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a technically driven EPM Specialist to join our Enterprise Solutions team in Bangalore. This role is built for someone who wants to go deep on technical design and implementation , building robust, scalable solutions on top of EPM platforms (Anaplan preferred). You will partner closely with our Product team, who define and prioritize business requirements, while our team owns the technical design, build, and delivery.
Our team: We are an international team covering business processes and systems together, as one. Each member brings different skills and strengths, and we're looking for someone who can add to and elevate the group as a whole. We value strong communication, transparency, respect, honesty, and a willingness to learn. We are committed to constant growth and upskilling: if you are interested in a particular technical direction, we're open to those conversations and will work with you on your professional development.
Why this role is different: This is a hands-on technical build role. You'll be translating requirements into elegant, well-engineered technical solutions. If you enjoy solving challenging integration and data problems, and want to grow your technical depth (ETL, APIs, system design), this role is designed for you.

What you'll do:
Partner with the Product team to translate business requirements into technical compose and build robust solutions on our EPM platforms (Anaplan/OneStream)
Compose, build, optimize and maintain data integrations between EPM systems and upstream/downstream platforms using ETL tools (Informatica preferred) and APIs
Own the technical build of planning and forecasting solutions, ensuring performance, scalability, and maintainability
Establish and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and technical documentation for the team
Troubleshoot and resolve sophisticated technical issues in EPM configurations and integrations
Evaluate new tools/technologies and support technical recommendations (including feasibility and ROI) for platform investments
Present solution compose to stakeholders, including senior technical and business audiences, as part of the wider team
Collaborate with Global Nasdaq engineering teams to deliver cross-functional technical solutions

What we're looking for:
5+ years of hands-on software development/technical configuration experience, ideally with Anaplan and/or OneStream
Strong technical foundation in system integration, experience with ETL tools (Informatica strongly preferred) and working with APIs
Comfort working with sophisticated data models and translating functional requirements into technical solutions
A designer and builder's mindset -  you are looking to strengthen your technical skills over time
Strong communication skills, and a collaborative, transparent, and honest working style
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
Willingness to learn the functional/accounting side (consolidations, allocations, intercompany eliminations, planning models) as needed to build better technical solutions

Nice to have:
Experience working in multinational, multi-geographic technology teams
Experience working in a fast pace environment
Exposure to corporate finance systems or FP&A tooling
